events.reason: Full context read. Developed in real work with dated, citable uses, and it keeps its own failure (T-024, T-025) and a correction. Project's own verification, one project, no independent reuse: its locators were not read here, because only published material is. Takers note: the kit states more than the record supports. 'Usually' and 'that is where the category dies' stand against the record's limits that no rate was measured, that climbing does not clear lower layers, and that the stopped-too-early check missed T-024 in advance. Read the limits before copying the kit. Its pointers to situation-personification and cast-and-fit lead to a contribution not admitted here; this one stands without them.

Admission of 2026-11-05 withdrawn under the bar published 2026-11-07. No adverse evidence beyond what the record itself states; the record is sound. The kit is the part a project copies in, and it says 'that's where the category dies' and that the root cause is 'usually' one layer up, while the record limits that: climbing does not clear lower layers, and no rate was measured. A warning in this reason does not travel with a copied kit. A replacement with an agreeing kit gets a fresh decision.

Offered by the curator's own project, so author and decider are the same role. Admitted under the bar 2026-11-07b after two independent reads (a different provider's model, closed input). The first held version 4c06557d for tests 4 and 6 (kit omitted that its evidence is self-checked; no dependency check before replacing parts), and the curator, whose own recorded reading was admit, agreed. The corrected version passed all seven tests on the second read. Both runs are disclosed; no other reader was run. Evidence: two uses, both in this one project, both checked only by the deciding role. Not shown: net value against cost, false alarms, use in any other project. Residual risk the tests do not cover: the author-decider frames the tests, input and reader. See published/answers/2026-11-16.md.
